chapter_note: Substrate teaching of Five Fathers structure dominates first half. The enumeration is genuine substratic cosmological cascade: Father of Greatness → Beloved of Lights / Great Spirit (emanations) → Third Ambassador with Pillar of Glory / Jesus the Radiance / Virgin of Light → Mind of Light → Form of Light. The fourth and fifth Fathers receive heavy Manichaean ecclesial overlay (apostle, churches, elect, catechumens) — confirmed by the fatigue score (-3.8 substrate, +7.7 ecclesial in 2nd half). The Call/Yokefellow material (i=62-64) is preserved as substrate since the Call IS a cosmic power in this tradition.
